column1: # Plant tree 67d7993da (65b0bc779^, every family-1 arm present) with 17 emit-time tags: the marshal_arith cycle, the NV_GET argument arm, the by-name dop leaf, the four write routes, IR_DEFINE role 0 and its eligible path,

# the two slim roads (A_SLIM_ROAD_Z the tiny fallback, A_SLIM_ROAD the staged box), the CALL2BB handoff (pending set, consume, consumer), and controls (CALL_ROUTE_FN, CALL_ROUTE_PROC_STAGED, the DEFINE role of every define).

# Populations: corpus_sources = every source under corpus/ with a scrip extension (4659, the rung suites' ALL.* compiled whole among them); rungs_entries = the 5027 entries of the seven rung suites, one file per entry

# (../harness/scripts/util_extract_rungs_entries.py), each compiled with the compile_args its attribute row declares; rungs_entries_bare = the same entries without them. Driver: ../harness/scripts/util_plant_pass.py, twelve wide.

# RESULT: every family-1 arm reads 0 on all three populations except A_SLIM_ROAD_Z, fired by exactly snobol4 define_params_30_restore_caller and define_params_60_restore_caller -- the reach hq_snobol4's verdict
# on 65b0bc779 found (the 29-formal ceiling of bb_tiny_shim_ok and the role-4 shim). Controls fired in all seven languages. C_DEFINE_ROLE4 fired nowhere: every role-4 DEFINE is the inl5 shim.

# One rung suite-entry compile crash: icon ladder__rung38_coexpr_an_activation_resumes_its_operand_generator (rc 134 at an emit_drive guard on the plant tree; cured by hq_icon's 25e3e8e2f, it compiles on HEAD, IcnRungs 893/893).

# util_plant_pass.py 2026-09-27 07:10 -- binary <scratch plant worktree>/scrip on tree 67d7993da pascal: a record-typed field of an anonymous record variable keeps its record type -- g.c.a of var g: record x: integer; c: q end is selected, assigned and written; planted files:  4 files changed, 17 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)
# SECOND PASS, THE SLIM ROADS ON THE CURED TREE (cto 2026-09-27): plant tree beaf84b26 (the role-4 shim takes 30 to 60 formals) with 6 emit-time tags -- A_SLIM_ROAD_Z and A_SLIM_ROAD at the two

# rt_proc_call_open_slim sites, C_SIG_Z/C_SIG and C_TINY_Z/C_TINY at the signature and tiny arms that precede them. Three passes: (1) scrip --compile over the three populations above; (2) MODE 3 (compile
# and run, 30 s, stdin /dev/null) over the SNOBOL4, Snocone and Rebus rungs entries with their declared compile_args, so code compiled at RUN TIME (EVAL, CODE) prints its tags too -- the population a
# compile-only plant cannot see; (3) the forced-positive control, SCRIP_NO_TINY=1 over the dyn-scope rungs entries and corpus sources, which must fire both slim tags.
# RESULT: both slim tags 0 in passes (1) and (2); in (3) A_SLIM_ROAD_Z fired in 330 SNOBOL4, 34 Snocone and 43 Rebus rungs entries and 290 SNOBOL4 corpus sources, A_SLIM_ROAD in 2 rungs entries and
# 6 corpus sources. So no program of any population reaches either slim road once the shim admits every DEFINE the SCC probe admits; the roads are retired again (the sites a loud x86_bomb).
